# Statement blocks of the rendering head that no test in cmd/dinah executes.
#
# TestEveryStatementOfTheRenderingHeadIsCoveredOrNamed reads this file. Every
# entry is a place the output check does not look, so an entry is a finding
# rather than a line of configuration: it says a block prints for a reader and
# nothing in the suite has ever read what it prints. Two assertions keep the
# pressure on. An entry naming a block the suite does execute fails, so a stale
# entry is pruned rather than left to accumulate, and an entry carrying no
# reason fails, so nobody adds one without saying why the block is unreached.
#
# A line is the block, then whitespace, then the reason. A blank line and a
# line opening with a hash are commentary.
#
# A block is named file:function#ordinal rather than by the line span the
# coverage profile spells it with. The ordinal is the block's rank among every
# block the profile reports for that function, covered and uncovered alike,
# ordered by where each one starts, so an entry moves only when the function it
# names is itself edited: an insertion anywhere else in the file leaves it
# alone, and a sibling block going from uncovered to covered leaves it alone
# too. A function here is a declared function, or a package-level variable
# built out of function literals, which is what refusalListings is. When the
# check reports a block, it prints this identifier alongside the profile's own
# span, and the identifier is the half that goes in this file.
#
# Two kinds of entry sit here and the difference is worth reading. Some blocks
# cannot be reached from a test at all, and say so. The rest are reachable and
# simply unreached: each is a human rendering the suite has never printed, and
# each is worth a test rather than a permanent line here.

help.go:verbHelp#2  verbHelp refusing a command it does not know, which helpFor settles before composing anything, so no invocation reaches it whether the help command or a help flag asked.
help.go:vocabularyValues#6  vocabularyValues giving up on a vocabulary source no listing answers to, which TestEveryVocabularySourceHasAListingThatAnswersIt refuses, so no declared source reaches it.
render.go:composeRefusal#2  the composer's fallback for a refusal name no shape declares, which the source-side guard fails a build over, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:composeRefusal#28  a composition splicing no fragment at all, which needs a shape offering no next step, and every shape offers one.
render.go:emitCanonical#2  the branch where the machine form will not marshal, which needs a value the library cannot build.
render.go:nextStepOf#4  the alternation answering with nothing, which needs a last member carrying a condition, and the guard fails a shape whose last member does.
render.go:refusalListings#2  the columns listing asked for before a workbench is open, which unknown-column cannot be raised before.
render.go:renderColumnLine#2  renderColumnLine handed no column, which emitColumn cannot produce: it draws the line only on an ok outcome, and every ok outcome of column new carries the column it wrote.
render.go:renderDetail#2  a card carrying a body, printed under its own line by show. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:renderWorkstreamLine#2  renderWorkstreamLine handed no workstream, which emitWorkstream cannot produce: it draws the line only on an ok outcome, and every ok outcome of the two workstream acts carries the workstream it wrote.
render.go:reportOutcome#4  the stale outcome of a response, which the cli head cannot provoke: a stale revision needs a second writer between the read and the act.
render.go:reportOutcome#5  the same, on the branch where the stale response carries a card.
render.go:reportOutcome#6  the same, writing the stale sentence.
render.go:reportOutcome#7  the unreachable outcome, which is by construction the outcome no invocation produces.
render.go:token#2  a token the catalog carries no rendering for, and every token the head prints has one.
render.go:workstreamRef#2  workstreamRef reading a session that has opened no workbench, which no card line reaches: a card line is drawn from a response, and there is no response until a workbench is open.
table.go:recordTableSite#2  the shipped binary's branch, where no test hook is armed. The suite arms the recorder for its whole run, so this is unreachable from a test by construction.
